question.title: How do you keep a marriage going for 50 years?
question.body: Getting married next spring. My parents divorced when I was 8 and I honestly don't know what a long marriage looks like day to day.

turns.text: Someone asked: how do you keep a marriage going for 50 years? What would you tell them?

Oh, well, Tony and I have been married fifty two years this June. The first thing is you don't go to bed angry. People say that and it sounds like a greeting card but we really did it. Some nights we stayed up till two in the morning but we talked it out.
That's lovely. Is there something you do day to day?

Every Sunday we cook together. Even when the kids were little and it was chaos. He chops, I season, and that's our time. And you have to laugh. When he backed the car into the mailbox in seventy nine I could have yelled, but I laughed and now it's our favorite story. Pick your fights. Most things aren't worth it.
